metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Given your enjoyment of 'Ted Lasso' and 'The Good Place', you'll appreciate the optimistic and character-driven humor of 'Parks and Recreation'. It's a feel-good sitcom focused on public service with a strong ensemble cast that builds a warm, comedic world.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: Like 'New Girl' and 'Silicon Valley', this show offers smart, fast-paced comedy with lovable characters. It's a workplace sitcom set in a police precinct, balancing laugh-out-loud moments with genuine heart.

metas.name: Community
metas.description: Fans of 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia' and 'The Good Place' will likely enjoy the meta-humor, pop culture references, and unique episode structures of 'Community'. It's a quirky comedy about a diverse study group at a community college.

metas.name: The Office (US)
metas.description: If you liked the ensemble cast and mockumentary style of 'The Office' (UK) and the workplace comedy of 'Silicon Valley', the US version offers similar observational humor and character development, creating a very watchable and often heartwarming experience.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: Similar to 'Ted Lasso' and 'New Girl' in its evolution of character and feel-good nature, 'Schitt's Creek' starts with a fish-out-of-water premise but blossoms into a genuinely heartwarming and hilarious story about family and self-discovery.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: For lovers of clever, layered comedy like 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia' and 'Peep Show', 'Arrested Development' offers incredibly dense and rewarding humor with a dysfunctional family at its core.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: If you enjoy adult animated comedies with witty dialogue and absurd situations like 'Rick and Morty' and 'Futurama', 'Archer' provides sharp, fast-paced humor with a spy-parody twist.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: This mockumentary about vampire roommates offers a delightfully silly and character-driven comedy, much like 'The Office' or 'Parks and Rec', but with a supernatural, absurd twist.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: For fans of animated comedies with heart like 'King of the Hill' and 'The Simpsons' (though not watched), 'Bob's Burgers' offers a unique blend of family dynamics, surreal humor, and genuine warmth. It's consistently lighthearted and clever.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: This is a charming and funny sitcom about a Korean-Canadian family running a convenience store. Its relatable characters and gentle humor make it a great companion to shows like 'New Girl' or 'King of the Hill'.

metas.name: Crazy Ex-Girlfriend
metas.description: This show blends comedy, musical numbers, and heartfelt drama in a way that might appeal to fans of 'Master of None' and 'The Good Place'. It's surprisingly smart and tackles complex themes with humor.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A modern mockumentary sitcom that shares the optimistic spirit and ensemble chemistry of 'Parks and Recreation' and 'The Office'. It's witty, heartwarming, and focuses on dedicated teachers in a Philadelphia public school.

metas.name: The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel
metas.description: If you appreciate sharp dialogue, period settings, and strong comedic performances like in 'Silicon Valley' or 'Master of None', this show about a 1950s housewife becoming a stand-up comedian is visually stunning and incredibly witty.

metas.name: The League
metas.description: For fans of the raunchy, fast-paced humor of 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia' and the competitive dynamics, 'The League' follows a group of friends obsessed with their fantasy football league.

metas.name: Toast of London
metas.description: A surreal and highly comedic British show about an aging actor. If you enjoy the offbeat humor of 'Peep Show' or 'Goodness Gracious Me', this offers a unique and hilarious perspective.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: Fans of sharp, cynical political satire like 'Silicon Valley' will find 'Veep' to be incredibly funny. It's a masterclass in insult comedy and the absurdity of political maneuvering.

metas.name: Santa Clarita Diet
metas.description: This is a comedic horror-sitcom that's lighthearted despite its premise. If you enjoyed the blend of genres and dark humor in 'Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency' or 'It's Always Sunny', this is a fun, quirky watch.

metas.name: Black Mirror
metas.description: Though not always light, the sci-fi anthology format with occasional comedic or thought-provoking episodes can appeal to fans of 'Rick and Morty' and 'The Good Place' for its speculative nature, but be mindful of darker themes.

metas.name: Blue Planet II
metas.description: For a complete shift to relaxing, visually stunning content like 'MythBusters' but focusing on nature, this documentary series is highly acclaimed and provides a calming, awe-inspiring viewing experience.

metas.name: Planet Earth II
metas.description: Similar to 'Blue Planet II', this is a beautifully shot nature documentary that's perfect for background viewing or pure relaxation, offering stunning visuals and fascinating insights into the natural world.

metas.name: The Great British Baking Show
metas.description: This is a quintessential feel-good reality competition. Its low stakes, supportive contestants, and charming hosts make it perfect for lighthearted, comforting background viewing, similar to 'Gogglebox' but with a creative focus.

metas.name: Nailed It!
metas.description: A hilarious and lighthearted baking competition where amateur bakers try to recreate complex desserts with predictably disastrous (and funny) results. It's pure, unpretentious fun, a great contrast to more intense reality shows.

metas.name: MasterChef Junior
metas.description: For a feel-good competition that showcases incredible talent and positive attitudes, 'MasterChef Junior' is surprisingly compelling and uplifting, featuring young chefs who are both skilled and charming.

metas.name: Somebody Feed Phil
metas.description: If you enjoyed the travel and discovery aspects of 'MythBusters' but want something more food-focused and inherently joyful, Phil Rosenthal's enthusiastic exploration of global cuisine is pure comfort food for the soul.

metas.name: Detectorists
metas.description: A gentle, understated British comedy about two friends who spend their weekends metal detecting. It's beautifully written, character-driven, and incredibly heartwarming, offering a unique and relaxing viewing experience.

metas.name: Fleabag
metas.description: While it has dramatic elements, 'Fleabag' is a brilliantly written, sharp, and often hilarious comedy with a unique voice that might appeal to fans of 'Master of None' and 'Peep Show' for its unconventional storytelling and witty observations.

metas.name: The Office (UK)
metas.description: If you enjoyed the mockumentary style and awkward humor of 'Peep Show', the original British 'The Office' is a foundational series in that genre, offering dry wit and relatable workplace scenarios.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: This musical comedy duo's show offers a quirky, deadpan humor that might appeal to fans of 'It's Always Sunny' or 'Community' for its unique comedic voice and musical numbers.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: A widely loved mockumentary sitcom that focuses on family dynamics with humor and heart, similar in tone to 'New Girl' and 'Parks and Recreation'.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A British sitcom with a strong cult following, offering a quirky and often absurd sense of humor that fans of 'Peep Show' or 'Goodness Gracious Me' might enjoy.

metas.name: Wellington Paranormal
metas.description: A mockumentary horror-comedy that spins off from 'What We Do in the Shadows'. If you enjoy that show's style and humor, this is a fantastic, lighthearted, and absurdly funny extension.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A hilarious and heartwarming coming-of-age comedy set in Northern Ireland during the Troubles. Its sharp wit and relatable characters make it a great companion to shows like 'The Office' or 'Parks and Recreation'.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: A workplace sitcom set in a large retail store. It offers consistent humor, likable characters, and a positive outlook, similar to the vibe of 'New Girl' or 'Parks and Recreation'.

metas.name: Crazyhead
metas.description: This supernatural comedy-horror series has a similar quirky and genre-bending feel to 'Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency', with a focus on humor and action.

metas.name: The Amazing Race
metas.description: A classic reality competition that combines travel, adventure, and lighthearted competition. It's a great feel-good show that appeals to viewers who enjoy the adventure aspect of shows like 'Fallout' but in a real-world, competitive format.

metas.name: Impractical Jokers
metas.description: This hidden-camera prank show is pure, unadulterated fun and lighthearted comedy. It's perfect for background viewing and guaranteed to bring a smile, much like the lighter moments of 'It's Always Sunny'.
